Sophie (Partnerships): Heads-up — CloudX marketplace listing + TitanHW joint announcement next Tue. Need a short SI co-sell intake + lead-claim protocol before we go live. Quick sync?

Ajay (BizDev): Timeline noted. What's our current rule for marketplace-originated leads? 24h claim window?

Matt (SalesOps): Default today is 48h field hold — if SI already has an active engagement, SI gets priority. We should capture edge cases (overlap, partner-owned accounts).

Claire (SI Lead): Agreed. Proposal: if SI has any active engagement (PQL, demo scheduled, SOW in progress) the SI retains ownership. Marketplace form leads route to partnerships queue + SI for an initial 48h hold. After 48h unclaimed -> field SDR.

Sophie (Partnerships): Nice. Let's standardize the policy. High-level rules: 1) marketplace-origin leads -> check SI engagement flag; 2) if partner (TitanHW/CloudX) marks lead partner_owned -> co-assign to partner + SI for 72h; 3) pure marketplace leads -> 48h hold then field. Drafting YAML for ops so it's deterministic.

Matt (SalesOps): Also add an account overlap check: if the account is in an SI territory list we should route to the SI even if there's no active engagement (to avoid cross-claims).

Ajay (BizDev): CRM tagging we need: marketplace_source, partner_tag, si_account. That enables automated routing and joint-credit calculations. Example tags: marketplace_source=cloudx, partner=titanhw, si=orion.

Sophie (Partnerships): YAML draft (for staging rules):
```yaml
claim_policy:
  - origin: "marketplace"
    initial_hold: 48h
    priority: ["si_engaged", "partner_owned", "field"]
    auto_release: true
  - origin: "cloudx-catalog"
    partner_bonus_window: 72h
    overlap_check: true
```

Matt (SalesOps): Can we also include a safety-net: if a marketplace lead contains an inbound SI referral code, auto-assign to SI immediately.

Claire (SI Lead): Yes please. And can we get a Slack ping to #si-routing when a partner-owned mark appears? That helps triage quick handoffs.

Orchestrator Bot: New routing rule created in staging: `marketplace-handoff-v2`. Preview link: https://staging.ops/redwood/rules/marketplace-handoff-v2. Scheduled deploy: 03/25 18:00 UTC.

Sophie (Partnerships): Perfect. Action items: Matt — update ops playbook + implement overlap check; Ajay — push CRM tag mappings and sample import; Claire — confirm SI channel webhook and test referral-code logic.

Matt (SalesOps): I'll implement the overlap check and run a 1-week pilot after deploy. Will post pilot checklist here. :white_check_mark:

Ajay (BizDev): I'll update the mapping docs and share sample CSV for the pilot.

Claire (SI Lead): Will validate webhook and confirm on Monday. Thanks all. :rocket:
